steps.title: Configure PCR Cycling Conditions
steps.instruction: Set the thermal cycler to the following parameters using the SuperScript™ III Platinum™ One-Step qRT-PCR Kit (Life Technologies Catalog #11732088):

substeps.instruction: Amplification cycles (40X): 95°C for 3 seconds, followed by 60°C for 30 seconds with a fluorescence acquisition step

steps.title: Analyze Amplification Curves
steps.instruction: Evaluate the real-time fluorogenic PCR results based on the following criteria for a satisfactory positive result:

substeps.instruction: Verify the presence of a sigmoidal curve (horizontal start, exponential rise, and plateau phase)
Confirm fluorescence intensity is suitable compared to a positive control
Identify a defined threshold (CT) value that is exceeded early in the log-linear phase
Confirm that No Template Controls (NTCs) do not produce a curve
Classify any result that does not exceed the threshold within 40 cycles as negative
